goal: Make the NeurIPS 36320 rebuttal maximally persuasive without exceeding the supported evidence.

winner.label: persuasive-bounded-v11
winner.primary_finding: Lead with the reviewer-recognized audit contribution, answer each reviewer concretely, and make the acceptance case independent of private post-submission E1 evidence.

findings: The submitted introduction already contains the practitioner-facing aim; the rebuttal may operationalize it as a bounded evidence check but must not claim the adoption gate was explicitly submitted.
The five-seed 92.6/92.1 comparison is not auditable because three zero-runtime backfills lack unique upstream IDs.
The 4G4H per-seed telemetry table matches all 40 frozen records and directly answers the reviewer's missing-data request.
The frozen DAPO DISAPPEARS verdict is unsafe: finite-sample paired-t MDE is 1.012 pp and the multiplicity step was not applied, so all E1 comparisons are treated as inconclusive.
Private E1 receipts are feasibility evidence only and are not independently reviewer-verifiable without an anonymized artifact.
next_actions: Paste the four replacement texts into the matching OpenReview notes before the deadline.
Preview and re-open every saved note; do not upload a revised PDF during a response-only window.
Do not quote the frozen E1 DISAPPEARS label.
Repair and independently review the E1 statistical pipeline before using it in an ACL or ARR paper.
Rotate the exposed W&B, Tinker, and Hugging Face credentials.
untested_gaps: No OpenReview note was posted or edited.
Private W&B and Hugging Face evidence is not independently visible to reviewers without an anonymized artifact.
Reference-KL dependence remains untested because E1 uses beta=0.
